tei:div.tei:p: "!#'um̐ḥ klong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥ rgyal ba rig 'dzin gyi srog 'khor dpal gyi gdu bu bzhugasaḥ ཿ

dbyings rig rgyal po stang dpyal ngasaḥ dus gsum dus med chen por rgyasaḥ rdo rje can gyi phrin las dngaḥ sngags lam thabs kyis rten cing 'brelaḥ bsam gyis mi khyab brjod mi langaḥ mthong thos reg gam rdzi phyogs phogaḥ btags pas grol ba rig 'dzin gyiḥ srog gi 'khor lo bshad kyis nyonaḥ bri gzhi bzang por rin po chesaḥ mu khyud rim pa bcu gcig dbusaḥ kun bzang yab yum thugs ka ruḥ 'od lnga'i 'khor lo 'bru lngas mtshanaḥ de'i phyi mu khyud gnyis pa laḥ rig pa yab kyi snying po niḥ
man ngag snying thig /

e ma ki ri ki riḥ mas ta bha li bha liḥ sa mi ta su ru su ruḥ kun+dha li ma su ma suḥ i ka ra su lī bha sa ta yeḥ tsa ki ra bhu li ta lce yeḥ sa mun ta tsar+ya su gha yeḥ bhi ti sa na bh+ya gu li yeḥ sa ka ri dhu ka naḥ ma ta ri bhe ta naḥ pa ra hi li sa naḥ ma khar te ke la naḥ saṃ bhu ra ta me ka tsa ra tang paḥ sur+ya gha ta ra e pa sha naḥ ra na bhe dhi sa ghu ti pa yaḥ ghu ra ghu ra sa ga kha ra na laṃḥ na ra na ra i tha pa ṭa laṃḥ sir na sir na bhe sa bhe sa ra sa baṃ laṃḥ bhun dha bhun dhaḥ tshi ṣa sa ke laṃḥ sa sā ri rī khe khā+e i ī ma mā ri rī la hā āḥ de'i phyir pad+ma 'dab brgyad laḥ mdun nas brtsam pa'i g.yas skor duḥ
rig 'dzin brgyad kyi snying po/

ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ hūm̐ kā ra āḥhūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ dha na saṃskṛ āḥhūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ mañdzu shrī mi tra āḥhūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ bi ma la mi tra āḥhūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ nā gardzu na āḥhūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ gu h+ya tsan+d+ra āḥhūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ ā tsar+ya pad+ma āḥhūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ ma hā gu ru sha rī raṃ shīn+taṃ ghar+bha āḥhūm̐ḥ de'i phyi mu khyud bzhi pa laḥ stong pa yum gyi snying po niḥ mas ta bha li bha liḥ sa mi ta su ru su ruḥ kun dha li ma su ma suḥ e ka ri li bha ta yeḥ tsa ka ra bhu li taḥ lce ye sa man taḥ tsar+ya su gha bhi ti sa na bh+ya gu yeḥ ke ri dha ke riḥ dha ha ka ma ha ri bhaḥ ha na sa ri bi hiḥ sa na ma khar tak+she la naḥ saṃ bhu da ra ta me k+sha tsa ra s+t+waṃḥ dha ba su t+ya gha ta ra aḥ ma sha na pa raḥ bhi hiḥ ti sa ghu ra laḥ ma smi sa ya ghu sti la taḥ ya ghu ra ghu raḥ brlang ga kha ka la ra na la ma saḥ na ra na ra lamaḥ i tha ra pa ta laṃḥ sir na bhe sa ral pa ghe laṃḥ ma māḥ sa sa ri rī li lī ma māḥ ra rāḥ mu khyud lnga par rtsibs bcu laḥ
rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul gyi snying po'au/

ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ rat+na ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ pad+ma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ karma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kro dhī shwa rī sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ ma hā badz+ra dha ra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ ma hā sur+ya rat+na ma hā kro dhī shwa rī bi da ma hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ hrīḥshat+ta sa man+ta pad+ma ma hā kro dhī shwa rī khā hi hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ sarba a mo ghā ma hā kro dhī shwa rī bi shwa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rtsibs mchan laḥ
sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyi snying po/

ā+oṃ gu ru shrī badz+ra yak+sha kro dha tsit+ta hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu h+ya dzñā na kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ āḥkro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ khroṃ ga ru ṭa sarba ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐ phaṭaḥ drug pa thig le nyi shu lngaraḥ karmā rak+sha ghi haṃ tiḥ bhe gha ra na so gad glingaḥ bhu ka ri la bha du triḥ raṃ pa ka la sa mi khyeḥ ma tang phas pher ras mi taḥ kha ṭa re ka sa mig rlungaḥ a kai ra na bhe tsaka shaḥ ya ri mu ta sa ghu liḥ yā sing ra rlung pa la yāḥ ma ma ko ling sa man+taḥ gha ra yaṃ pa ra mi tiḥ bu ga sing ha pha gha laḥ ra mi se pi kha ta paḥ big khu ma la pa taṃ kiḥ sa ma nye wa dhe ra paḥ badz+ra satwa tri tro meḥ ghe wa su ghar rna ma yaḥ dharmā pa ti sa gu liḥ ras mi sa ma khas rgad tseḥ ru pa sa mi mi ta liḥ nga tig pa yaṃ ka li saḥ ga tsa pa yaṃ sa i taṃḥ karma e a a nu saḥ saṃ kri ma ma karma taḥ nga la khe pa ki li saḥ bar mtshams longs sku'i snying po dngaḥ rigs drug klong grol yi ge spelaḥ
ā+oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ 'a a ha sha sa maḥ bdun par pad 'dab zhe gnyis laḥ
zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyi snying po/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ badz+ra tsit+ta ā+oṃḥ a a a badz+ri bha dra sa man+taḥ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rikḥ muṃ dhā te shwa rīḥ ā+oṃ dzin dzikḥ lāṃ dwe ṣa ra tiḥ swā rat+na dh+rikḥ māṃ mo ha ra tiḥ āṃ a ro likḥ pāṃ rā ga ra tiḥ hāṃ pra dzñā dhṛkḥ tāṃ badz+ra ra tiḥ k+ṣīṃ hi rā dza yaḥ hūm̐ lā s+ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ trāṃ ā gar+bha yaḥ trāṃ mā l+ye sa ma ya hoḥ hrī ha hūm̐ pad+ma pra da maḥ hrīṃ gī ti rā go haṃḥ dz+riṃ ku ru pā ṇiḥ āṃ nirti rā ga ya meḥ me dha ra ṇi swā hāḥ dzaḥdhū pe pra be shaḥ thiṃlha nis+sa raṃ bha ya swā hāḥ hūm̐ puṣ+pe ā be shaḥ hūm̐ swa rā dza ya swā hāḥ baṃ dī pa su gi riḥ mūṃ shrī āṃ rā ga ya swā hāḥ hoḥghan+dhe tsit+taḥ ā+oṃ mu ne kreṃ swā hāḥ ā+oṃ mu ne hūm̐ truṃ swā hāḥ ā+oṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hāḥ ā+oṃ mu ne breṃ swā hāḥ ā+oṃ mu ne k+ṣaṃ swā hāḥ ā+oṃ mu ne ye swā hāḥ ā+oṃ ya mān+ta krita phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra dha ra ma hā kro dhī shwa rī dz+wa li nī hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ pra dzñān+ta krita phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ rat+na dha ra ma hā phaṭaḥ hūm̐ pad+man+ta krita phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ pad+ma dha ra ma hā phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ bigh+nān ta krita phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ karma dha ra ma hā phaṭaḥ brgyad par khrag 'thung yab yum niḥ
'dus pa mdo'i snying po'o/

ā+oṃ a kra ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ ka ta ma hā kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ sarba ta thā ga ta kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ bud+dha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ rat+na kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ karma shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ karma kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ rak+sha shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ rak+sha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ sa nu shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ sa nu kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ gu h+ya shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ gu h+ya kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ yak+sha shrī he ru ka hūm̐ḥ yak+sha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ḥ
gau ri ma brgyad/

ā+oṃ badz+ra gau rī haḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra tsau rī haḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha haḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra bai ta lī haḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī haḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī haḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra sma sha ni haḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li haḥ
singha ma brgyad/

ā+oṃ badz+ra singha mu khī heḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra bya gh+ri mu khī heḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra sri la mu khī heḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra shwa na mu khī heḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra gṛd+dha mu khī heḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra kaṅka mu khī heḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra kā ka mu khī heḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra u lu kā mu khī heḥ dgu par dbang mo nyer brgyad dngaḥ bstan pa spyi yi snying po bkodaḥ ma nu rak+sha sī bh+yoḥ brah+ma ni bh+yoḥ rau trī bh+yoḥ beṣ+ṇa bai bh+yoḥ ku mā rī bh+yoḥ in+d+ra rī bh+yoḥ badz+ra piṅga laṃ bh+yoḥ a mṛtaṃ bh+yoḥ sau mya bh+yoḥ daṇ+ḍa daṃ bh+yoḥ rak+ṣa sī bh+yoḥ bhak+ṣa sī bh+yoḥ ra ti badz+ra bh+yoḥ ru ti ra mat+ta bh+yoḥ e ka tsa ri ṇī bh+yoḥ ma no ha raṃ bh+yoḥ sid+dhi kaṃ bh+yoḥ bā ya bī bh+yoḥ ma hā mā ra ṇa badz+ra bh+yoḥ ag+nī bh+yoḥ bha ra hi bh+yoḥ tsa muṇ+ḍi bh+yoḥ su ta ni bh+yoḥ wa ru ṇī bh+yoḥ badz+ra ma hā kā li bh+yoḥ badz+ra tsa kā la bh+yoḥ badz+ra kum+bha kar+ṇa bh+yoḥ badz+ra lam+bo da ra bh+yoḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra ār+ya te dza te nga dzaḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra a mu khī hūm̐ḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra lo ka baṃḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra bhasmi pa la ya ba tu hoḥ a āḥ i īḥ u ūḥ ṛ ṝḥ l̥ l̥̄ḥ e ā+aiḥ o ā+auḥ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha ngaḥ tsa tsha dza dzha nyaḥ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇaḥ ta tha da dha naḥ pa pha ba bha maḥ ya ra la waḥ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tun+teḥ ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa dataḥ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shrā ma ṇaḥ
che ge mo

'i nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sdig sgrib thams cad rig pa'i klong du shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hāḥ tshe dang bsod nams zhing khams thams cad rig pa'i ngang du puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ 'khor 'das thams cad rig pa'i ngang du pā shaṃ ku ru swā hāḥ dgra bgegs dug lnga dug gsum thams cad rig pa'i ngang du mā ra ya phaṭaḥ bcu par 'od lnga'i mu khyud bskoraḥ bcu gcig 'od lnga'i pa ṭa risaḥ de nas rab tu gnas pa niḥ yang gsang sgrub pa'i gzhung bzhin laḥ thig le chen po'i snying po rnamasaḥ rtsa sngags nyid dang sbrel la bzlaḥ shis pa brjod cing me tog gtoraḥ rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnasaḥ dbang bskur byed na sdom pa gsumaḥ cho ga bzhin du bzung byas laḥ bstan bur brgya phyag maṇ+ḍal dbulaḥ tshar gcig bklags la spyi bor bzhagaḥ hoḥ rgyal ba rig 'dzin zhi khro'i lhaḥ btags grol srog gi 'khor lo 'disaḥ skal ldan slob ma
che ge mo

'iḥ sgo gsum smin par mdzad du gsolaḥ grol zhing gang bar mdzad du gsolaḥ rgyas dang 'phel bar mdzad du gsolaḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta rat+na karmā a bhi ṣiñtsa swā hāḥ zhes brjod gnas lngar gtugs byin rlobasaḥ 'di ni chos sku'i ring bsrel dngosaḥ sde gsum rgyud lung man ngag dngaḥ rgyal ba yongs rdzogs srog 'khor yinaḥ spyi bo mgrin pa mchan khung duḥ sus bcangs sdig pa kun las grolaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba bsnyen dang mtshungasaḥ 'das dus gdung dang ring bsrel dngaḥ sa g.yo sgra 'od 'ja' tshon 'byungaḥ nyi zla gzas zin sa g.yos dngaḥ 'od dang sgra dang sad ser rimasaḥ mu ge phyugs nad byung ba'i tsheḥ byang chub sems dang ldan pa yisaḥ rim bzhin rnam snang mi bskyod paḥ rin 'byung dpag med don grub dngaḥ bzang mo rang rang rigs kyi ljagasaḥ yig 'brus mtshan par bsgom ste bklagasaḥ tshogs dang mchod pa srog 'don dngaḥ mchog dman dud 'gro yan chad laḥ sbyin pa gtong zhing rnal 'byor bsgomaḥ nyin zhag gcig la mtshon pa naḥ snga zhog byer dang dros gting zugaḥ nyin gung snyoms la dgong kha 'khrugaḥ srod byer srod yol 'khrug pa dngaḥ phyed snyoms tho rangs 'khrug pa'i tsheḥ so so'i dus gnad nges pa bzhinaḥ bklag dang tshogs gsag rgya cher byaḥ gsang sngags mos pa can la gsungasaḥ dad pa can la smos ci dgosaḥ rmongs pa'i dud 'gro la btags kyangaḥ thugs rje'i dpyang thag chad pa medaḥ

the tshom log lta can dag niḥ rdo rje can gyi phrin las dngaḥ 'dul tshul thabs kyis spangs pa'i phyiraḥ gsang tshig rig sngags sman dang dpyadaḥ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mthuḥ kun la bskur bas bslu 'gyur zhingaḥ skal pa chad pa snying re rjeḥ 'di dang mjal zhing mos pa rnamasaḥ las 'phro can du gdon mi zaḥ snying thig bstan pa nyams pa'i tsheḥ kun tu bzang pos byin brlabs paḥ rang byung rdo rje dang 'phrad nasaḥ mthong thos dran reg grol bar shogaḥ sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ
